requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Implement AI-driven productivity, scan workflow, and device manageability solutions tailored for SMB customers, including features like Perfect Print and Perfect Scan.
requirements.Rationale: AI solutions are a key differentiator, addressing SMB needs for efficiency and ease of management, especially for non-IT users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and device management capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered features (Perfect Print, Perfect Scan) demonstrably improve workflow efficiency and device manageability in user testing by at least 30% over baseline.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the product to achieve HP's lowest business TCO for SMB tank printers, minimizing both upfront and operational costs.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a primary purchasing driver for SMBs, and TCO is a core value proposition for Magellan.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient consumables, high-yield tanks, and low-maintenance design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product TCO is at least 10% lower than previous HP SMB tank printers and leading competitors, validated by cost analysis.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Customer-Replaceable and Service Center Parts
requirements.Description: Enable customer-replaceable parts (PHA) and make MINK serviceable at service centers, with a target for customer replaceability if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT staff, so easy serviceability reduces downtime and support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design constraints for modular and accessible components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least 80% of common maintenance tasks can be performed by end users without technical training, as validated by usability studies.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Consumables
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error and support incidents, improving reliability and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of tank and bottle interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 100% of bottles must be uniquely keyed to prevent incorrect installation in field tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated SMB portal for managing printers, targeting unmanaged and lightly managed SMB environments.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies device management for non-IT users, improving efficiency and user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with AI manageability solutions and telemetry systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal allows users to add, monitor, and manage at least 10 devices with role-based access and reporting, validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HP's PaaS offerings, enabling advanced service models and solutions integration.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS support is a strategic goal for HP to drive recurring revenue and solution stickiness.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software platform compatibility and service APIs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is fully certified with HP's PaaS platform and passes all integration and billing tests.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Speed Improvement
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU: Support PDL/PS and achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets business customer performance expectations and competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware development for speed and protocol support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves minimum 25 ppm (mono) and 20 ppm (color) in standardized print tests, with full PDL/PS compatibility.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel environmental certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are increasingly required in procurement and valued by SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Product design must meet Blue Angel criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is certified by Blue Angel prior to product launch.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box for the printer, a new feature for this segment.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service downtime and lowers TCO for SMBs by allowing users to replace key maintenance components.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for user-replaceability and consumables logistics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by user in under 5 minutes with no tools, as validated in usability testing.

requirements.Title: High Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Achieve 60% recycled content plastic in product construction, exceeding major competitors (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and customer demand.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Final product BOM shows at least 60% of plastics are from recycled sources, verified by supplier certifications.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Meets SMB expectations for reliability and reduces perceived risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty policy is implemented and communicated in all launch regions.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities and seamless integration with the HP App.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require flexible printing options, including from mobile devices.
requirements.Dependencies: Mobile app development and printer firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is discoverable and fully functional via HP App on iOS and Android in field trials.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to support device usage tracking, proactive support, and solution enhancements.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry enables better manageability, support, and future solution improvements for SMB customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure data collection and cloud integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is securely transmitted, stored, and accessible for at least 90% of deployed devices in pilot tests.
